status.en: 19 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 35% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 19 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 35 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: PKK militants have withdrawn from several camps in northern Iraq, including Metina and four border-area sites, as part of a peace process with Turkey. Iranian drones struck a Kurdish opposition camp in northern Iraq, while US envoy Tom Barrack visited Iraq to discuss economic partnership and security cooperation. Iraq increased output at the Nasiriyah oil field by 10,000 barrels per day and continues operations against remaining ISIS pockets in the security vacuum after the US pullout. Four drug traffickers were sentenced in Dhi Qar and four Baghdad employees were caught taking bribes. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: PKK-militante har trukket seg tilbake fra flere leirer i Nord-Irak, inkludert Metina og fire grenseområder, som en del av en fredsprosess med Tyrkia. Iranske droner slo et kurdisk opposisjonsleir i Nord-Irak, mens USAs representant Tom Barrack besøkte Irak for å diskutere økonomisk partnerskap og sikkerhetssamarbeid. Irak økte produksjonen ved Nasiriyah-olje­feltet med 10 000 fat per dag og fortsetter operasjoner mot gjenværende IS-lommer i sikkerhetsvakuumet etter USAs tilbaketrekning. Fire narkotikasmuglere ble dømt i Dhi Qar og fire ansatte i Bagdad ble tatt for å ha tatt bestikkelser. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
